question: If the radius of a sphere is 30 cm, then its surface area is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The surface area of a sphere is found directly using the formula 4 × π × r².

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (30)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 900

⇒ Surface Area = 3600π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 3600 π cm².**
